Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Tagging in to troubleshoot the portal behavior.

Quick checklist (we see these regularly):
1) Invite delivery: I'll re-send a fresh invite from the admin console and mark it as a reissue (this clears a stale token).
2) Magic link TTL: our magic link defaults to 15 minutes; if the email client preloads links it can cause a session mismatch. Reissuing should remedy.
3) PDF rejection: couple of portals block PDFs with certain XMP/metadata layers. Can you try flattening the PDF (Print -> Save as PDF) and re-upload? Alternatively send the W-9 to me and I'll attach it to the vendor profile manually.
4) PO mapping: we can accept your column names. If you send one exported row we'll create an import mapping (GL_Code -> Account_Code, PO_ID -> PO_Number, Supplier_Tax -> Tax_ID). I've pasted a small sample mapping CSV into OPS ticket OPS-4231.

I'll open a short internal ops ticket and reissue the invite now. Sergio — I'll copy the new invite ID below once it's issued. Elena — if that still fails, can you share the exact user agent string from the failed attempt or paste the console error?

Creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4231

Attachments (for reference): vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (blank fields observed)

Thanks,
